name: signal_firpm
comment: MATLAB Signal Toolbox firpm — Parks-McClellan optimal equiripple FIR via Remez exchange. Supports all four linear-phase types: Type I (even N, sym), Type II (odd N, sym, Q=cos(ω/2)), Type III (even N, anti-sym, Q=sin(ω) — 'hilbert' ftype), Type IV (odd N, anti-sym, Q=sin(ω/2) — 'hilbert' ftype). Each non-trivial type folds Q into the Remez problem via D' = D/Q, W' = W·Q, runs the same kernel, then reconstructs h via the type-specific cos→sin or half-integer-shift expansion. Approximate-equal MATLAB R2025b ~1e-3 across ten probed designs covering Type I LP/BP/HP/weighted/multi-band + Type II LP + Type III/IV Hilbert. KNOWN GAPS: 'differentiator' ftype (currently accepted, builds an anti-symmetric FIR, but Remez δ doesn't match MATLAB — different effective D/W convention; values diverge ~10-30% though shape is qualitatively correct), fresp function-handle form, 3rd `res` output struct, lgrid cell-form. Octave 11.1.0 ships firpm in the signal package (not core).
